verses.greek: Διὸ ἀναπολόγητος εἶ, ὦ ἄνθρωπε πᾶς ὁ κρίνων· ἐν ᾧ γὰρ κρίνεις τὸν ἕτερον, σεαυτὸν κατακρίνεις, τὰ γὰρ αὐτὰ πράσσεις ὁ κρίνων·
verses.literal: Therefore inexcusable you are O man everyone you who are judging In that which for you judge the other yourself you are condemning the for the same things you do who are judging.
verses.dgt: Therefore you are without excuse, O person, everyone who judges; for in what you judge another, you condemn yourself, because you who judge practice the same things.

verses.greek: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τὸ κρίμα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν κατὰ ἀλήθειαν ἐπὶ τοὺς τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντας.
verses.literal: We know however that the judgment the of God is according to truth upon those the such things practicing
verses.dgt: And we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

verses.greek: λογίζῃ δὲ τοῦτο, ὦ ἄνθρωπε ὁ κρίνων τοὺς τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντας καὶ ποιῶν αὐτά, ὅτι σὺ ἐκφεύξῃ τὸ κρίμα τοῦ θεοῦ;
verses.literal: Suppose you now this O man you who are judging those the such things practicing and doing them yourself that you yourself will escape the judgment the of God?
verses.dgt: But do you suppose this, O person who judges those who practice such things and does them, that you will escape the judgment of God?

verses.greek: ἢ τοῦ πλούτου τῆς χρηστότητος αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς ἀνοχῆς καὶ τῆς μακροθυμίας καταφρονεῖς, ἀγνοῶν ὅτι τὸ χρηστὸν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς μετάνοιάν σε ἄγει;
verses.literal: Or the riches of the kindness of Him and the forbearance and the patience despise you not knowing that the kindness the of God to repentance you leads?
verses.dgt: Or do you despise the riches of his kindness and tolerance and patience, not knowing that the kindness of God leads you to repentance?

verses.greek: κατὰ δὲ τὴν σκληρότητά σου καὶ ἀμετανόητον καρδίαν θησαυρίζεις σεαυτῷ ὀργὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως δικαιοκρισίας τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.literal: Because of however the hardness of you and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up to yourself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of justice the of God
verses.dgt: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath for yourself in a day of wrath and revelation of God’s righteous judgment,

verses.greek: ὃς ἀποδώσει ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: who will give to each according to the works of him
verses.dgt: who will repay each person according to their works:

verses.greek: τοῖς μὲν καθʼ ὑπομονὴν ἔργου ἀγαθοῦ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν ζητοῦσιν ζωὴν αἰώνιον·
verses.literal: to those who indeed with endurance in work good glory and honor and immortality are seeking life eternal
verses.dgt: to those who by endurance in good work seek glory and honor and immortality, eternal life;

verses.greek: τοῖς δὲ ἐξ ἐριθείας καὶ ἀπειθοῦσι τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πειθομένοις δὲ τῇ ἀδικίᾳ ὀργὴ καὶ θυμός,
verses.literal: to those however of self-interest and disobeying the truth being persuaded about however the unrighteousness wrath and anger
verses.dgt: but to those from selfish ambition who disobey the truth and obey unrighteousness, wrath and anger.

verses.greek: θλῖψις καὶ στενοχωρία, ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ψυχὴν ἀνθρώπου τοῦ κατεργαζομένου τὸ κακόν, Ἰουδαίου τε πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνος·
verses.literal: tribulation and distress upon every soul of man which is working the evil of Jew both first and also of Greek
verses.dgt: Affliction and distress will come upon every human soul who works evil, to the Jew first and also to the Greek,

verses.greek: δόξα δὲ καὶ τιμὴ καὶ εἰρήνη παντὶ τῷ ἐργαζομένῳ τὸ ἀγαθόν, Ἰουδαίῳ τε πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνι·
verses.literal: glory however and honor and peace to everyone who is doing the good to Jew both first and to Greek
verses.dgt: but glory and honor and peace to everyone who works good, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.

verses.greek: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν προσωπολημψία παρὰ τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: Not for there is partiality with the God.
verses.dgt: For there is no partiality with God.

verses.greek: Ὅσοι γὰρ ἀνόμως ἥμαρτον, ἀνόμως καὶ ἀπολοῦνται· καὶ ὅσοι ἐν νόμῳ ἥμαρτον, διὰ νόμου κριθήσονται·
verses.literal: As many as for without the Law have sinned without the Law also will perish and as many as in the Law have sinned through the Law will be judged
verses.dgt: For as many as sinned without law will also perish without law, and as many as sinned under law will be judged through law.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἀκροαταὶ νόμου δίκαιοι παρὰ τῷ θεῷ, ἀλλʼ οἱ ποιηταὶ ⸁νόμου δικαιωθήσονται.
verses.literal: not for the hearers of the law are righteous with the God but the doers of the law will be justified.
verses.dgt: For the hearers of law are not righteous before God, but the doers of law will be justified.

verses.greek: ὅταν γὰρ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ νόμον ἔχοντα φύσει τὰ τοῦ νόμου ποιῶσιν, οὗτοι νόμον μὴ ἔχοντες ἑαυτοῖς εἰσιν νόμος·
verses.literal: When for Gentiles the not the law having by nature the things of the law they may do these the Law not having to themselves are a law
verses.dgt: For whenever Gentiles who do not have law do by nature the things of the law, these, though not having law, are a law to themselves.

verses.greek: οἵτινες ἐνδείκνυνται τὸ ἔργον τοῦ νόμου γραπτὸν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν, συμμαρτυρούσης αὐτῶν τῆς συνειδήσεως καὶ μεταξὺ ἀλλήλων τῶν λογισμῶν κατηγορούντων ἢ καὶ ἀπολογουμένων,
verses.literal: who show the work of the law written in the hearts when they are bearing witness to them their conscience and between one another the thoughts accusing or also presenting a defense
verses.dgt: They show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness with them, and their thoughts among one another accusing or even defending them,

verses.greek: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὅτε κρίνει ὁ θεὸς τὰ κρυπτὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου διὰ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
verses.literal: on day when judges the God the secrets the of men according to the gospel of mine through Christ Jesus.
verses.dgt: on the day when God judges the hidden things of people according to my good news through Christ Jesus.

verses.greek: Εἰ δὲ σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ἐπονομάζῃ καὶ ἐπαναπαύῃ νόμῳ καὶ καυχᾶσαι ἐν θεῷ
verses.literal: If however you yourself a Jew are called and you rely on law and you boast in God
verses.dgt: But if you call yourself a Jew and rest on law and boast in God,

verses.greek: καὶ γινώσκεις τὸ θέλημα καὶ δοκιμάζεις τὰ διαφέροντα κατηχούμενος ἐκ τοῦ νόμου,
verses.literal: and know the will and approve the things being superior being instructed out of the law
verses.dgt: and know his will and approve the things that matter, being instructed from the law,

verses.greek: πέποιθάς τε σεαυτὸν ὁδηγὸν εἶναι τυφλῶν, φῶς τῶν ἐν σκότει,
verses.literal: you are confident then that you yourself a guide being of the blind a light to those in darkness
verses.dgt: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light of those in darkness,

verses.greek: παιδευτὴν ἀφρόνων, διδάσκαλον νηπίων, ἔχοντα τὴν μόρφωσιν τῆς γνώσεως καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας ἐν τῷ νόμῳ—
verses.literal: an instructor of the foolish a teacher of infants having the embodiment the of knowledge and of the truth in the law
verses.dgt: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, having in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—

verses.greek: ὁ οὖν διδάσκων ἕτερον σεαυτὸν οὐ διδάσκεις; ὁ κηρύσσων μὴ κλέπτειν κλέπτεις;
verses.literal: You who are then teaching another yourself not do you teach? You who are preaching not to steal do you steal?
verses.dgt: then you who teach another, do you not teach yourself? You who preach not to steal, do you steal?

verses.greek: ὁ λέγων μὴ μοιχεύειν μοιχεύεις; ὁ βδελυσσόμενος τὰ εἴδωλα ἱεροσυλεῖς;
verses.literal: You who are saying not to commit adultery do you commit adultery? You who are abhorring the idols do you rob temples?
verses.dgt: You who say not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

verses.greek: ὃς ἐν νόμῳ καυχᾶσαι, διὰ τῆς παραβάσεως τοῦ νόμου τὸν θεὸν ἀτιμάζεις;
verses.literal: You who in law boast through the transgression of the law the God dishonor you?
verses.dgt: You who boast in law, through transgression of the law do you dishonor God?

verses.greek: τὸ γὰρ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ διʼ ὑμᾶς βλασφημεῖται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, καθὼς γέγραπται.
verses.literal: the For the name the of God through you is blasphemed among the Gentiles even as it has been written.
verses.dgt: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the nations because of you,” just as it is written.

verses.greek: Περιτομὴ μὲν γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἐὰν νόμον πράσσῃς· ἐὰν δὲ παραβάτης νόμου ᾖς, ἡ περιτομή σου ἀκροβυστία γέγονεν.
verses.literal: Circumcision indeed for profits if the law you shall do if however a transgressor of law you shall be the circumcision of you uncircumcision has become.
verses.dgt: For circumcision indeed benefits you if you practice law, but if you are a transgressor of law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

verses.greek: ἐὰν οὖν ἡ ἀκροβυστία τὰ δικαιώματα τοῦ νόμου φυλάσσῃ, οὐχ ἡ ἀκροβυστία αὐτοῦ εἰς περιτομὴν λογισθήσεται;
verses.literal: If therefore the uncircumcision the requirements of the law shall keep surely the uncircumcision of him for circumcision will be reckoned?
verses.dgt: Therefore, if the uncircumcised person keeps the righteous requirements of the law, will not that person’s uncircumcision be counted as circumcision?

verses.greek: καὶ κρινεῖ ἡ ἐκ φύσεως ἀκροβυστία τὸν νόμον τελοῦσα σὲ τὸν διὰ γράμματος καὶ περιτομῆς παραβάτην νόμου.
verses.literal: And will judge the by nature uncircumcision the law fulfilling you who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of law.
verses.dgt: And the person uncircumcised by nature who fulfills the law will judge you who, through letter and circumcision, are a transgressor of law.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ ὁ ἐν τῷ φανερῷ Ἰουδαῖός ἐστιν, οὐδὲ ἡ ἐν τῷ φανερῷ ἐν σαρκὶ περιτομή·
verses.literal: Not for the one on the outward a Jew is neither the one outwardly the outward in flesh is circumcision
verses.dgt: For the one outwardly a Jew is not a Jew, nor is outward circumcision in flesh circumcision,

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ὁ ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ Ἰουδαῖος, καὶ περιτομὴ καρδίας ἐν πνεύματι οὐ γράμματι, οὗ ὁ ἔπαινος οὐκ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλʼ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: but he who is on the inward a Jew is one and circumcision is of heart in spirit not in letter of whom the praise is not of men but of the God.
verses.dgt: but the one inwardly is a Jew, and circumcision is of the heart, in spirit, not in letter, whose praise is not from people but from God.
